bio: Christina Sayers Wickstead is a board member with experience in communications, brand storytelling, and creative strategy.
longBio:
Christina Sayers Wickstead is a board member with experience in communications, brand storytelling, and creative strategy. She has worked with social-impact organisations to amplify the voices of young people and is committed to building platforms that centre rangatahi lived experience.

Christina supports Kick Back with narrative strategy and helps ensure our kaupapa is communicated clearly to partners, funders, and the community.
